name: Hologlide J57 cam droid
description: Hologlide J57 cam droids, also known as Hologlide J57 Podrace Cam Droids, were a type of floating droid capable of recording video. They were equipped with a repulsor wing, a transmission antenna as well as multiple cameras. The droids were powered by a mini-reactor. Several J57s were used on the planet Tatooine to record the Boonta Eve Classic podracing event.
